हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: “Tum Agar Saath Ho” is a romantic drama about two middle-aged, unmarried individuals —Kabeer, a powerful yet emotionally distant businessman, and Tara, a kind but struggling woman who has been overlooked by society due to her age and speech impediment. When fate brings them together, they enter an unexpected marriage. Their journey explores love beyond age, status, and societal expectations, while hidden truths and family conflicts threaten to pull them apart. Watch now!
